banque.name: Le hall de la banque
banque.alt: The grand marble hall of the village bank, painted in ink and gouache: through the open brass entrance door on the far left a canal and a little bridge glitter in the sun; a pink pig-shaped money box bumps its snout at the door; a blue saucer heaped with coins sits on a small round table; a duchess in purple fans herself on a throne of gold bars; six coloured doors (red, blue, green, yellow, purple and orange) line the back wall; a cashier stacks towers of silver coins at his counter; a rag doll in a cowboy hat waves a green banknote; old uncle Frank shows a glass case of old coins; a clerk bangs a big rubber stamp on a slip; a girl rows a boat shaped like a giant gold coin across a puddle; a jolly old count with a gold coronet and red sash turns the pages of a ledger at a lectern; and two tellers shake hands over a big paper cheque beside a little brass balance scale.

doors.label: le guichet
doors.hint: Go through the green door to the cashier's window

doors.label: les prêts
doors.hint: Go through the purple door to the loans office

doors.hint: Go through the orange door to the trade office

doors.hint: Go through the yellow door to the finance office

doors.hint: Go through the blue door to the tax office

guichet.name: Le guichet
guichet.alt: The cashier's hall on the bank's first floor, painted in ink and gouache: a dark green door on the left; a proud lady with a gold star on her coat is admired by two bowing neighbours; a wicker basket of groceries and a tall thermometer gauge hang on the wall; a little girl drops a copper coin into a money box; a boy with a giant crayon pays at a lectern; through the big window a riverside scene is full of little figures, a man in a mustard suit opens his wallet, and in the right-hand pane a lady takes her banknotes from a clerk at a little riverside kiosk.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the green door to the bank hall

zooms.label: la fenêtre
zooms.hint: Look closer through the big window behind the counter

bureau.name: La fenêtre du guichet
bureau.alt: Close-up through the window behind the cashier's counter, onto a sunny river: a long old barge is moored at the grassy bank; a blank gilt-framed gold card hangs on the window mullion with a feather duster below; a little guard boy holds up a big brass key beside a gate whose padlock hangs open; a ferry carries one huge gold coin across the river while a heron stands in the shallows; a boy kneels to hand over a toy garage shaped like a little house; a small boy rolls a giant copper coin along the path; two young men play chess at a table; a moustached banker twirls a giant brass key, and a smiling woman holds out her hands as coins drop into them.

prets.name: Le bureau des prêts
prets.alt: The busy loans office upstairs in the bank, painted in ink and gouache: a shelf of little figurines runs along the top left; a clerk holds a banknote up to the window under a magnifying glass; another clerk drops one gold coin into each of a row of plain tins; a mother presses the button of a brass payout machine and an envelope slides out; a wigged notary sips tea among admiring fans; a purple door stands at the back; a granny signs for a cart of prunes; a small fountain splashes in a stone alcove beside a rocky cliff; a girl times a gushing tap with a stopwatch, and a grey terminal stands by the brass tap.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the purple door to the bank hall

zooms.label: l'étagère
zooms.hint: Look closer at the shelf of little figurines at the top left

pupitre.name: L'étagère des prêts
pupitre.alt: Close-up of the wooden shelf in the loans office: club members drop coins into a baby's cot; a girl sorts banknotes into piles by colour and size; a poet with his arm raised recites a verse while sliding coins across a little counter, while a little toy duke in a plumed hat holds up a big gold coin for his grey cat, beside a row of bronze statuettes.

commerce.name: Le bureau du commerce
commerce.alt: The trade office of the bank, painted in ink and gouache, opening onto a marsh: a shelf of little figurines on the top left; a town crier rings his bell with a board on his back; a lady in a tall cone hat swings a big blank price tag; coins pour out of a man's pockets; frogs sit on the roofs of market stalls on stilts in the marsh; a trader drops a coin into an overflowing jar; a man holds out a big pot for everyone's coins; a baker carries a bag of coins; a terracotta door stands at the back; a ginger cat sits on a tower of boxes; a girl surveyor marks out a fenced plot, and a cow with a sandwich board and a cowbell parades past.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the terracotta door to the bank hall

zooms.label: l'étagère
zooms.hint: Look closer at the shelf of figurines at the top left

comptoir.name: L'étagère du commerce
comptoir.alt: Close-up of the wooden shelf in the trade office: a stern lady points her finger, demanding; a little tax man in a bowler hat posts a coin into a brass-studded box; a plain brown bunny sits beside a golden trophy brimming with coins; a girl and a boy share a pie between them; and a beaming young man holds up a trophy and a basket full of coins.

finances.name: Le bureau des finances
finances.alt: The finance office of the bank, painted in ink and gouache: a teal door on the left; a banker clutches his head over a creased chart; a clockwork model town of farm, factory and shop turns its gears while a toy train carries coins; a mouse carries a scroll bigger than itself; a man drags a heavy ball and chain with a blank tag; a clerk hands a lady a ribboned scroll; a woman counts coins at a desk under a green lamp; an old map hangs over a sideboard of little figures; a waiter serves a pizza shaped like a pie chart; coins hop into a wire basket; a big key tops a pair of balance scales, and a budgie perches on a jar of coins.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the teal door to the bank hall

zooms.label: le buffet
zooms.hint: Look closer at the sideboard under the old map

tableau.name: Le buffet sous la carte
tableau.alt: Close-up of the sideboard under the old map in the finance office: a golden eagle soars up across the map; a cow slides down a red zig-zag arrow; gold coins dance over an open ledger; a little door stands ajar with a teacup on its step; a little shop-box has toppled and spilt its coins while its shopkeeper clutches his cheeks; a black top hat brims with gold coins; and bumblebees hover over a strip of lawn with a small blank slate.

impots.name: Le bureau des impôts
impots.alt: The tax office of the bank, painted in ink and gouache, with warm cream walls: a man in a worn coat shrugs; an old man in a rocking chair takes an envelope from a postman; a slate-blue door at the back; a mayor in a sash hands a rolled grant to a girl beside her little brass submarine; a woman counts coins at a table; a man answers a ringing telephone; a man drops coins into a tree-shaped box; a sideboard holds little figures; a banker hands a bag of coins to an inventor on a winged bicycle; a glum man slumps beside an empty tray, and a man runs off with a little bag.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the slate-blue door to the bank hall

zooms.label: le buffet
zooms.hint: Look closer at the sideboard of little figures

tiroir.name: Le buffet des impôts
tiroir.alt: Close-up of the sideboard in the tax office: a fish bobs on a coiled spring; a stern inspector in a bowler hat poses with a big rubber stamp over a blank form; and a builder holds his folding ruler open in a big V.

placements.name: Le bureau des placements
placements.alt: The investment office of the bank, painted in ink and gouache, open to an orchard: villagers feast under fruit trees; a little stream runs past the doorway; a lady with a magnifying glass studies a painting, a parrot perched behind her; a lady holds a fan of certificates; a copper-red door at the back; a girl drops a coin into a flowerpot where a green sprout grows; a man in a flat cap sits on a pyramid of gold coins; a shelf holds little figures; a man puts his savings in an iron safe; ivy climbs the cream wall, and a brass pipe pours gold into a basket.

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Go back through the copper-red door to the bank hall

zooms.label: le buffet
zooms.hint: Look closer at the sideboard of little figures

coffret.name: Le buffet des placements
coffret.alt: Close-up of the sideboard in the investment office: a farmer leads a billy goat beside a bucket of gold coins; an economist peers into a misty crystal ball; and top-hatted bosses shake hands in front of a little factory.
